title: Traffic
intro: What the hall's traffic is made of, from NetFlow or IPFIX. Aggregate only: nobody sees what a person visited.
noCollector: No flow data yet. The flow collector is an optional container that the switches or the router send NetFlow or IPFIX to. How to set it up:
rulesError: The event's own service rules (FLOWS_SERVICES) can't be read, so only the built-in ones are used: {{message}}
stale: the collector hasn't sent anything for over a minute
privacy: Raw flows are kept for {{days}} days, then only totals.
areasText: Areas are the seat blocks on the floor plan.
servicesText_one: A service is only named once {{count}} different seat used it. {{volume}} went to services fewer seats used.
servicesText_other: A service is only named once {{count}} different seats used it. {{volume}} went to services fewer seats used.
seatsText: Only the volume and the kind of traffic, to spot problems. Never which services or sites.
